header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the appellant nor any intimation is received. Same was
body: the position on the last two dates of hearing, which shows that counsel for the appellant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for non-prosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
